cleanIntro: Morini's position on this pistol is that it needs almost nothing, and the routine is mostly about NOT doing things. No lubrication at all — the factory lubricated it with long-lasting grease and that is the end of it. A soft cloth after every session, special cleaning pellets for the bore, and no product of any kind on the air cylinder. ⛔ The one hard date on this gun is not a cleaning interval: compressed-air cylinders must be emptied and disposed of TEN YEARS after their production date, which is stamped on the cylinder.

steps.title: Cylinder off before anything else — and it can come off charged
steps.action: Unscrew the compressed-air cylinder from under the barrel. It can be removed even when it is not empty; a small amount of air escapes from the spacing chamber as it comes off and that hiss is normal. With the cylinder off the pistol cannot fire, which is the state you want before a rod goes into the barrel.
steps.quote: The compressed air cylinder can be unscrewed and exchanged even if not empty. While doing so a small quantity of air from the spacing chamber will escape.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 7. COMPRESSED AIR CYLINDER, printed p.7

steps.title: Check the cocking lever — a lever that will not lift means no air, not a fault
steps.action: If the cocking lever will not lift, the pistol has no air or not enough of it. That is worth knowing before you go looking for a mechanical problem: on the 162EI a dead lever is a pressure symptom first. Check the cylinder's built-in manometer, and check that the lock lever is not blocking the cocking lever.
steps.quote: If you cannot lift the cocking lever, it means that your pistol does not contain air or that the pressure of the air contained in the cylinder is not enough and does not permit to have an adequate velocity and therefore the shots would result lower.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 2. LOADING THE PISTOL, printed p.6

steps.title: Soft cloth after every session — and nothing on it
steps.action: Wipe the pistol with a soft cloth after every shooting session, using no product at all. This is not laziness on Morini's part: the frame carries an electronic trigger unit and the factory grease inside is meant to stay where it is, so anything you add is a solvent working against it.
steps.quote: It is recommended, however, to clean the pistol with a soft cloth after every shooting without using any product.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 10. MAINTENANCE: IMPORTANT, printed p.8

steps.title: Special cleaning pellets for the bore — that is the published method
steps.action: For the bore, Morini names cleaning pellets made for the purpose. Oil goes into the barrel only if the pistol is going to sit unused for a long period, and then it MUST be cleaned out before the pistol is fired again — an oiled air barrel throws the first shots wide and can dieselling-spike the pressure.
steps.caution: The barrel should be oiled internally only if it is not used for long periods. It is then to be cleaned before using the pistol again.
steps.quote: For cleaning the barrel bore, the use of special cleaning pellets, made for this purpose, is recommended.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 10. MAINTENANCE: IMPORTANT, printed p.8

steps.title: ⛔ No lubrication anywhere — the factory already did it
steps.action: Do not lubricate the pistol. Morini states plainly that the individual parts were lubricated at the factory with long-lasting lubricants and that no further lubrication is necessary. Adding oil to a match air pistol's mechanism is how people turn a 35,000-shot trigger into a sticky one.
steps.caution: Forbidden to use any corrosive products or oil for cleaning.
steps.quote: No lubrication is necessary, as lubrication of the individual parts has been done in the factory, with long lasting lubricants.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 10. MAINTENANCE: IMPORTANT, printed p.8

steps.title: The cylinder gets a dry mop and a calendar check
steps.action: The air cylinder is cleaned with a soft dry mop and nothing else — no detergent, no oil, no product. And check its dates: Morini requires cylinders to be emptied and safely disposed of ten years after the production date, and both dates are noted on the cylinder itself. That is the owner's responsibility, not the dealer's.
steps.quote: The compressed air cylinders must be emptied and safely disposed 10 years after production date. The production and disposal dates are noted on the compressed air cylinder.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 7. COMPRESSED AIR CYLINDER, printed p.7

steps.title: Long lay-up: air out of the cylinder, pistol off, dry and dark
steps.action: If the pistol is not going to be used for a while, unscrew the air cylinder and release the air from it. Store the pistol switched off, dry, away from dust, damp, sunlight, heat and anything corrosive. Cylinders must also be emptied before any flight or other transport.
steps.aside: Remember to empty out all cylinders before air flights or any other transport.
steps.quote: If the weapon is not used for a longer period of time, we recommend to unscrew the air cylinder and release the air from the cylinder.
steps.cite: Morini CM 162EI Compressed Air Pistol Instruction Manual — Manual CM 162EI EN-DE-IT-FR (file title on morini.ch's downloads index) — 7. COMPRESSED AIR CYLINDER, printed p.7

deepAbsentReason: Morini publishes NO disassembly of the CM 162EI — the book has no dismantling section at all. Its maintenance chapter is one paragraph and it points the other way: "The pistol does not need any special maintenance, except normal inspection and service regurarly and/or when necessary", and "No lubrication is necessary, as lubrication of the individual parts has been done in the factory, with long lasting lubricants." ⛔ The one component that might invite a screwdriver is the one most explicitly barred: "The compressed air tank including the valve must not be manipulated. Risk of injury!" and "Do not tamper on cylinder including the valve! Danger! If you violate this rule, the guarantee expires." A 200-bar aluminium cylinder is not an owner-service item. ⚠ Morini also records that the use of force while stripping the gun discharges the manufacturer from warranty and recommends periodic testing by an authorised gunsmith. There is nothing deeper to present here, and none has been invented.

cleaning.name: EXTERIOR
tasks: ⛔ No product of any kind — no oil, no corrosive cleaner

cleaning.name: BORE
tasks: Special cleaning pellets made for the purpose
Internal oil ONLY before a long lay-up, and cleaned out before firing again

cleaning.name: ⛔ LUBRICATION
tasks: None. The factory lubricated it with long-lasting lubricants

cleaning.name: AIR CYLINDER
tasks: Dry soft mop only — no detergent, no oil
⛔ Emptied and disposed of 10 years after the production date on the cylinder
Emptied before any flight or transport

reassembly: Bore clear of cleaning-pellet residue, and of oil if the pistol was oiled for storage.
Compressed-air cylinder screwed on by hand — never forced, never over 200 bar.
Cocking lever lifted once to confirm there is pressure.
Electronics on and the pistol stored switched OFF when finished.
fncheck: Cylinder back on and the pistol pointed somewhere safe: lift the cocking lever — it should come up cleanly. Read the cylinder's built-in manometer and confirm there is working pressure. ⛔ A lever that will not lift is a pressure problem, not a mechanical one; refill or change the cylinder and check the lock lever is not blocking it.
